source_role: PASS 4 - a real logged-out browser session, which is the only way to ask FlightRadar24 anything. Scripted requests get 403 site-wide.
method: Chrome navigation to the N102DZ aircraft page, then same-origin fetch of five further aircraft from inside that page so all six share one real session.
finding: The FlightRadar24 page for N102DZ is NOT removed. HTTP 200, full identity block, MODE S A00C85, TYPE CODE GLF5. The empty history table is the free tier's seven-day window; the unrelated control N628TS behaves identically.
does_not_establish: What this page displayed in May 2026. A page loading today cannot testify about a table's contents eight months ago. 'The page was taken down' is refuted; a narrower purge-and-restore claim is beyond this method in either direction.
counterargument: A logged-out free-tier session is the weakest view FlightRadar24 offers. A paid tier shows 90 days to 3 years, and this test cannot see what a paid tier would show for the disputed window.
